statement: Let H=(C^2)^{⊗4}, E_i(A)=(I_i/2)⊗Tr_i(A) (normalized one-site erasure at site i, factors kept in order), F_1(A)=Σ_{i=1}^4 E_i(A). (E10) Prove or refute: for EVERY density ρ on H and EVERY complex rank-3 orthogonal projector P, Tr[P F_1(ρ)] ≤ 3; equivalently, the sum of the three largest eigenvalues of F_1(ρ) is at most 3. Determine the equality cases. Equality holds for pure product ρ with Range(P) spanned by the product vector and two of its single-site orthogonal excitations.
context: By physics-2 v3 (reviewed in w57, 0F/0M/0m; parent adoption pending), (E10) together with the reviewed two- and three-erasure bounds would imply the original Ky-Fan k=3 majorization for 0≤p≤1. That implication is the author’s; this duty concerns only (E10).
